name: Fish meal, protein 70%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 68-75% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Lupin, white
description: Seed of white lupin (Lupinus albusL.). White lupin is a white-flowered grain legume cultivated for its seeds for animal feed and human consumption.

name: Cobalt selenite
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoO3Se.

name: Sunflower meal, oil < 5%, dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled or partially dehulled sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Maize, high moisture
description: Humid maize grain (Zea maysL.). This product contains 60-70% dry matter. Other name: humid corn (USA).

name: Fish oil, anchovy
description: Oil extracted from fish of the anchovy family (Engraulisand other genera).

name: Urea
description: Organic chemical compound with the chemical formula CO(NH2)2. Urea is a non-protein nitrogen compound used in ruminant feeding as a cheap source of nitrogen. Feed-grade urea contains about 42-46% nitrogen, which corresponds to 260 to 288% crude protein equivalent.

name: Copper chloride dihydrate
description: Copper(II) chloride is the chemical compound with the formula CuCl2·2H2O.

name: Calcium sulfate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaSO4·2H2O. Alternative spelling: calcium sulphate (UK).

name: Sorghum
description: Sorghum grain (Sorghum bicolor(L.) Moench). The nutritional values for monogastric animals correspond to low-tannin varieties.

name: Barley distillers grains, whisky production, fresh
description: Fresh byproduct of whisky manufacture, obtained from the distillery of barley grains (Hordeum vulgareL.), and consisting of spent grains.

name: Processed animal proteins, pig
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy pigs slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. Note:check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 19-22% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 19% and 22% protein (in dry matter).

name: Wheat straw
description: Byproduct of the harvesting of wheat grains (Triticumspp.) consisting of the dry stalks of the wheat plant.

name: Soybean molasses
description: Syrupy byproduct of the manufacture of protein concentrate obtained by aqueous alcohol extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.).

name: Whey, dried, with added fat 15-30%
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of cheese, to which milk fat has been reincorporated up to a content of 15-30% (as fed). Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Ferric phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FePO4. Other names: iron(III) phosphate, ferric phosphate.

name: Rice shorts, oil > 5%, crude fibre < 5%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in fragments of endosperm and germs. This product has not been defatted.

name: Zinc oxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnO.

name: Manganese methionine
description: Organic chemical compound consisting of a complex of methionine and manganese used as a source of organic manganese. These products have a variable manganese content.
